proof.fact: Control interface class COMM, subclass ACM at107
Control interface string CDC Abstract Control Model (ACM), attached to descriptor at630
Control interface gets first usb_interface_id, data gets subsequent ID at644; sole bound ACM function therefore expects control00/data01 (source expectation, runtime UNTESTED)
opts protocol defaults to USB_CDC_ACM_PROTO_AT_V25TER; copied to control descriptor at670

descriptor_source.transition_scope: Descriptor source bytes and USB matching identity unchanged; kernel source pin updated for DART v2.2 fix. Serial is a fixed profile string, not a kernel-version assertion.

host.classification: FRAME_VALIDATED is transport only; hardware/boot UNTESTED and recovery UNVERIFIED
limits: Quiet observation is bounded, not a promise no later bytes can arrive
Opening/configuring CDC ACM may assert modem control lines; it does not authorize NVMe probe
Exclusive-open/advisory lock and identity checks do not prove hardware recovery
No network, package installation, watchdog, reset, reboot or auto-rebind actions
host.probe: Separate probe-once CLI subcommand and exact primary invocation gate; same gate required at transport API; path never invoked

identity.after_open: Require matching character-device major/minor and re-read identity before termios/serial I/O
identity.before_open: Re-read complete candidate identity and compare inodes/paths/busnum/devnum; reject ambiguity
identity.excluded: Old sourcehelper/m1n1/gserial products fail exact product+serial+ACM control descriptor matching

protocol.freshness_scope: Fresh nonce correlates one response; no DT/firmware/boot or content-age guarantee
protocol.integrity_scope: Length+SHA256/footer detects corruption/truncation; no cryptographic peer authentication
protocol.line_endings: LF only; CRLF and extra fields rejected
protocol.request: J614S_REQ_V1 <32 lowercase hex nonce> <literal command> LF
protocol.response: J614S_FRAME_V1 <same nonce> <same command> <decimal bytes> <lowercase SHA256> LF + exact payload + LF J614S_END_V1 <same nonce> LF
protocol.stable_data: Source copy bounded to maximum+1; frozen copy hashed, full frame assembled in RAM before one timeout-wrapped cat
